name: odr-file-intake-poc
description: ODR File Intake pre-submission validation POC (Placement + Recall)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @odr/api" "npm run dev -w @odr/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/api && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p infra
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run cdk -- deploy
scripts.synth: npm run build:web && npm run cdk -- synth
